Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the very first step by prematurely concluding that Frank Lowy was the answer. In the initial analysis, after the WebSurfer only provided a search result snippet mentioning Frank Lowy as "Bid chief," the Planner jumped to the conclusion that Lowy was the man born on October 22, 1930, without verifying his birth date or checking if he was the only presenter (the Wikipedia page later revealed four presenters: Frank Lowy, Ben Buckley, Quentin Bryce, and Elle Macpherson). This premature confirmation led to a confirmation bias loop where the Planner repeatedly instructed the WebSurfer to verify a date that had not yet been established as fact, wasting resources on failed Britannica lookups when the information was already available on the Wikipedia pages visited in subsequent steps.
